feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 May 2026 8:33am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 26 May 2026 at 8:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Locally Strong Winds Wednesday morning.


##Synopsis##

High pressure continues to cover the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Variable force 3 or less, settling mainly north or northwest 3 or 4 this morning, but occasionally increasing 5 in the west of the area later this afternoon & this evening. Then gradually veering east or northeast 4 or 5 in all waters tonight, but occasionally touching 6 in the south of the area from dawn on Wednesday.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming mainly slight this evening, and slight or moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast mainly force 4 or 5, but occasionally 6 in the south of the area. Then increasing east or southeast 5 or 6 Wednesday evening, and perhaps occasionally touching 7 in the south and west of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate overnight into Thursday.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with occasional showers developing overnight into Thursday.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, but occasionally moderate or poo in any showers later.
